segments.text: Chouhi joins Kazuto along with Kan'u after the two discover him together. Unlike Kan'u, who holds a more reserved master-servant-like relationship with Kazuto, she treats Kazuto like an older sibling and calls him "big brother," similar to how she treats Kan'u.
From Wikipedia
劉備・関羽と共に、弱い人たちを少しでも助けたいと旅をしている少女。
粗野な振る舞いが目立つが、それも子供ゆえ。本当は甘えん坊である。
蜀一番の元気印の鈴々も、少しは大人に……なるわけもなく。相変わらず、翠とつるんでいるらしい。
季衣とは仲が悪いような……見方によっては仲が良いような、そんな関係。
そろそろ恋する乙女の意識が発露してきているらしい……？
弱い人たちを助けるために関羽と共に旅をしている。
関羽と互角の力があるが、如何せん子供なため、よく失敗したり関羽に怒られたりしている。
めちゃくちゃ食いしん坊で、大食漢。
必殺技：「突撃敢行」「猛虎の撃」「猛虎粉砕撃」
夢想†奥義：「蛇矛槍打」
夢想†秘奥義：「堅固防遏」
関羽と並び称される元気印の蜀の豪傑。
突撃粉砕勝利が合言葉の鉄砲玉娘。
相変わらずのペタンコ。
初代：
与関羽一起，一刀在刚开始时所会面的少女。
明明还是个小孩子，却挥舞着一把比身高要长几倍的蛇矛砍倒敌人的烈火美少女。是个能与関羽匹敌的豪杰，奈何还是个小孩子，时而因为恶作剧而被関羽怒叱。尽管如此她还是非常冷静，原本也是个爱撒娇的孩子。
她还会与离战场以外不远的地方的孩子们一起玩耍，抓抓虫子什么的，拥有着与年龄相符的一面。
真恋姬：
与刘备・关羽一同，想要尽可能多地帮助弱者们而进行着旅行的少女。
明明是个矮子，却爱用与其完全不相称的巨大巨大的蛇矛（だぼう）。
虽然有着足以与关羽势均力敌的武力，无奈因为还是个孩子，常常失败被关羽怒责。
粗鲁的言行十分扎眼，但那也是因为还是个孩子。其实是个撒娇鬼。
然而，十分讨厌被当成孩子对待。

segments.text: One of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Koihime†Musou series, Kan'u shows up shortly after Kazuto is transported back in time and saves him from a group of bandits. From Wikipedia
劉備・張飛と共に庶人の暮らしを守るべく、義憤に燃えて各地を旅していた少女。
生真面目な性格をしており、性に対しては人一倍羞恥を感じるタイプ。
濃ゆい面子の揃っている蜀の中心人物として、日々苦労を重ねている。
今作では、一刀直属の近衛隊の育成に力を注ぎつつ、若手育成に精を出している。
相変わらず春蘭とは好敵手な関係……らしい？
庶人の暮らしを守るべく義憤に燃えて各地を旅している少女。
理想家で、力のない人々が平和に暮らせる世の中を作るために日々奮闘している。
必殺技：「闘刃」「青龍の刃」「青龍逆鱗の太刀」
夢想†奥義：「闘気顕現」
夢想†秘奥義：「戦塵颱風」
蜀の武神として大陸中にその名を馳せる武将。
桃香の元で一刀を補佐しつつ、若手の育成にも精を出している。苦労性なのは相変わらず。
一刀刚来到三国志世界时遇见的少女。
挥动那把比人的身高还要长的青龙偃月刀，将袭击一刀的盗贼赶走的豪杰。向一刀诉说收复大陆上战乱的旋涡、替天行道的愿望，发誓效忠于他。
是个理想家，为了让世上弱势的人们过上平和的生活而每天奋斗着。性格一本正经，属于面对H时要比别人更要难为情的类型。爱吃醋，当目睹一刀与别的女性喋喋不休的时候就会不高兴起来。但是，本人并没有发觉自己在吃醋。

segments.text: Kuon is the head of the Oda Clan and the main heroine of the Sengoku † Koihime series.

She is a visionary leader with a strong vision for the future that she can adapt at need to the situation. Despite her often cool manner toward outsiders, she agonizes over the sacrifices she needs to make as a leader as much as or more than Kensuke. Seen as an oddball by many, she just happens to think in a manner that differs from most.
She frequently agonizes over 'using' Kensuke, but this doesn't stop her from doing so as needed for the good of all. She is very much a believer in the big picture, even when it hurts.

segments.text: The main protagonist of the Sengoku†Koihime series, a student at Franchesca Academy and Kazuto's nephew. He serves the Oda Clan as a retainer and general and is assigned the leader of the Kensuke Squad.

He was trained extensively and harshly by Hongou Kazuto's many wives (all the girls from Shin Koihime Musou), and while he isn't a match for them, he is more than skilled enough to make him an above-average warrior in the Sengoku era.

Kensuke possesses a varied lineup of skills ranging from weaponscraft and tactics to cooking and the making of simple devices like smoke bombs and signal flares. He is also brave and level-headed, tending to take circumstances as they come without letting them get him down. He has inherited his uncle's natural philandering ways (though he protests this frequently when others point it out to him), and he gathers women without even realizing he is doing it.

segments.text: Touko is a retainer and general in the Oda Clan. She is also Koyasha's mother and the matriarch of the Mori Family.

As a fighter, she is far closer to a berserker than a samurai, slaughtering enemies with abandon, bloodlust, and a psychotic grin on her face. segments.text: Koyasha is a retainer and general in the Oda Clan. She's also Touko's daughter and the successor to the Mori Family.

Like mother, like daughter, she flies into battle with a psychotic grin on her face. Don't look her in the eyes, or she might decide you are challenging her. Don't expect common sense from her, since her primary pleasure in life is slaughtering her enemies.
In the course of the story, she grows a great deal, though it doesn't change her essential nature at all.

segments.text: The main protagonist of the Koihime†Musou series, Kazuto is a sophomore at Franchesca Academy who was trained by his grandfather in kendo and is a fan of The Romance of the Three Kingdoms. One day, he was on his way to the school from the dorms when something happened. He suddenly wakes up, after falling from the sky in the form of a shooting star, in the Three Kingdom's ancient China, and because of his clothes, manner of speak and/or way that he arrived people believe he's the Heaven's Messenger, or so convince him to say that as people won't believe/understand he came from the future. In Shin Koihime†Musou, he can be found by the members of the future Shoku, Gi, or Go kingdoms.

On Gi's route Kazuto works as City Patrol Captain and later become one of Gi's generals. On Go's he's trained as a tactician and also serves as Breeding Horse as people will follow easier if they believe their ruler has the blood of a Heaven's people. On Shoku's route he has the role of something like a "Religious Leader", as Heaven's Messenger is believed by the people to be their saviour, also he shares the ruler role with Ryuubi.
